title: Asray Muk Gaye Fatima Jaiyan Day Bawafa Teray Bajon
body:
Tu Latheyaye Zeen Ton Lut
Khaimayan Ch Pay Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Asi Hoiyan Be Rida
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Bawaan Kata Kay
Karbal Di Khaak Tay
Jadh Sam Gaya Ghazi
Fer Inna Ma Diyan Sab
Ayetan Nu Aakay
Gaya Shimr Rasiyan Paa
<<DIVIDER>>
Teray Alam Layi Ghazi
Naizay Tay Char Gayan
Sab Chadran Ghirn Kay
Tu Alma Waleya Uth
Vaikh Karbala Vich
Har Bhen Di Wafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Laash Tay Sanu
Rowan Ton Shimr Nay
Enj Rokeya Ghazi
Saday Sar Vich Zakhm Tay
Mu Khoon Naal Pijh Gaye
Diti Rohn Di Saza
